# A CAD declared at a fraction GnuCash will not keep.
#
# GnuCash writes an ISO currency without a fraction and looks it up by code
# when reading the book back, so a fraction stated here is a session value the
# file never holds. The mismatch is therefore still there on the next run, and
# on every run after it.
#
# Counted as a change, that made an unchanged ledger rewrite the book every
# time it was imported — each run leaving another timestamped backup, for a
# difference no save could remove. A book moved between two supported
# distributions meets this without anybody typing an odd fraction at all,
# because GnuCash disagrees with itself about KRW: 1/100 before 5.15, 1 after.
#
# What this fixture produces: one CAD commodity and one account. Importing it
# twice must report nothing to save the second time.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_an_iso_fraction_does_not_rewrite_the_book.py.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 1000
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
